comment: Manually-tracked installed sources that auto-detection can't see (plugin-loaded, ~/.agents/, ~/Downloads/_Archive/repos/, etc.). Format: array of 'owner/name' strings. Edit this file to keep cross-checks accurate. Also embedded in the 'Cascade Discovery Scan' claude.ai routine — refresh both when adding installs.
own_comment: Repos Sam authors — excluded from the freshness check (--check-updates) so it never flags his own commits as 'stale'. Owners swsounds42/* and swsounds/* are auto-excluded too; add cross-owner repos here.

explored_not_integrated.comment: Repos cloned/downloaded to ~/Downloads/_Archive/repos/ but not yet symlinked into ~/.claude/skills/. Track here so weekly discovery scan doesn't re-recommend them.

skipped_with_reason.disler/claude-code-hooks-multi-agent-obs: Evaluated 2026-05-19. Strong tech (Bun+Vue+SQLite+WebSocket, 12 hook events, AgentSwimLane viz). Skipped: overlaps Cascade's hook capture + drift detection, demands 2 long-lived dev processes per session, per-event Anthropic API spend via --summarize, premise is parallel-agent teams (not Sam's daily workflow). Patterns worth stealing if future need arises: (1) Haiku-summarize-each-event utility, (2) swim-lane viz over existing .cascade/sessions/*.jsonl.
